arguments.sql:
WITH matches AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
)
SELECT m.Id, m.Title, 'PostId' AS matched_column, l.LinkTypeId,
       COUNT(l.Id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.RelatedPostId) AS other_post_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.RelatedPostId = m.Id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS self_links
FROM matches AS m
LEFT JOIN postLinks AS l ON l.PostId = m.Id
GROUP BY m.Id, m.Title, l.LinkTypeId
UNION ALL
SELECT m.Id, m.Title, 'RelatedPostId', l.LinkTypeId,
       COUNT(l.Id), COUNT(DISTINCT l.PostId),
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.PostId = m.Id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM matches AS m
LEFT JOIN postLinks AS l ON l.RelatedPostId = m.Id
GROUP BY m.Id, m.Title, l.LinkTypeId
ORDER BY 1, 3, 4

arguments.sql:
WITH related_counts AS (
    SELECT p.Id,
           p.Title AS post_title,
           COUNT(DISTINCT l.RelatedPostId) AS related_post_count
    FROM posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS l
        ON l.PostId = p.Id
       AND l.RelatedPostId <> p.Id
    WHERE p.Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
)
SELECT post_title, related_post_count
FROM related_counts
WHERE related_post_count = (
    SELECT MAX(related_post_count)
    FROM related_counts
)
ORDER BY post_title, Id
